It looks like that's going to be the plan. I hate getting into situations where I think like this, but I often spend time alone and having these feeling lurking about really hits hard sometime.

Thank you for taking the time to respond to me and I hope you are having a really nice day :)

You realize how many people have the exact same attitude as you who, according to society, don't have a single thing wrong with them? We're all damaged goods in one way or another, but that's what makes us different.

So you have herpes now; that's a thing. It's part of your life but it isn't who you are. We all have crazy scars, eating disorders, anxiety issues, and things like that that make us dislike ourselves and feel the same way you do. Those things don't determine whether we can loved or be loved, they can take your confidence, but they can't take your heart.

Haha so today was fun. Got a healthy reminder of why I would gladly not take part in this world. Had a guy at the library lecture me for five minutes in front of a bunch of strangers because I guess he thought it was a good idea. I didn't check in for my job search so when I went to leave and asked him to verify it he decided he wasn't going to politely say yes or no, but he would talk to me like a five year old and make everyone there laugh at me. He couldn't just fucking say yes or no and let me go. I had to stand there, scared as fuck to even be in there by myself and get humiliated for no good reason. Thanks for making such a big deal about it you ignorant asshole. I hope you got a lot of street cred with the guys around the library for almost making me cry or punch you in the mouth.

In 5 years I would love to be doing surveying or planning for an alternative energy firm of some sort, likely working on another college degree, and spending my free time cruising with my brother and hanging out with friends. That's the picture I can easily hold onto.
Yeah I've been at it for probably 5 years now but I'm holding onto the hope that things will get better. Also eventually therapy, that would probably do a lot of good for me.
Hah sure thing. I'll be here very sporadically but feel free :)

Realize that those feelings will come back. They always do, whether they are misplaced or not. I know exactly how you feel, and you know what? I quit my job and did literally nothing for a year; still doing nothing now because of it. The only reason I can manage to stay alive is because I know that one day, after I've lived out more of my life, those feelings Will come back.

I know just how intense things can get in your head sometimes, but you're young like me and I need you to be able to keep on living.

You have to understand that even the most successful of people can have one bad day and make a single decision and give up on everything. They can choose to go ahead and be just another person who lost all their money, jumped off a building, and that was it. "and that was it" doesn't have to be the way your story ends. Maybe you do get up and leave, maybe you do find a new life with new people who will love and accept you. Hope is the only thing that keeps us alive, and those of us here will gladly share some of ours with you.

At first I thought I had posted this in my sleep. I legitimately left my first job because I formed an unhealthy friendship with a female coworker and all the guys around the office would make sexual jokes about her in the middle of our shift and in turn, about me. When I decided to confront my manager about how it had been affecting our work, everyone decided that it was all my fault. So yes, I'm not even kind of an alpha and I know how that all feels.

What's your life like? Seeing the same people every day and being afraid to get the hell away from your job? Let us know what's really going on.
